why: The student says an all-zero row is fine for a page with no links. That is the documented RowsNeedNotSumToOne misconception, because every row has to sum to 1. The student also misses that the row is all zero because int division truncates, not because the page has no links: counts sum to 5, so the page does have links.

concepts.why: This is the wrong rule that a page with no links can have an all-zero row. Its row should be 1/N in every column, and this page does have links anyway.
